Test measurement invariance between the X and Y factors

Source: R/rsa-mplus-invariance.R
fit_rsa_mplus_invariance.Rd

Writes, runs, and reads a sequence of Mplus confirmatory factor models that test whether matched X and Y indicators measure their factors in the same way: configural, metric (equal loadings), and scalar (equal loadings and intercepts). Scalar invariance is what identification = "invariance" in create_rsa_mplus_model() assumes when it reads the latent line X = Y as equality on the response scale.

Usage

fit_rsa_mplus_invariance(
  data,
  measurement,
  pairs = NULL,
  free_intercepts = NULL,
  blocks = list(),
  usevariables = NULL,
  modelout,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  run = TRUE,
  Mplus_command = NULL,
  quiet = TRUE
)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing the indicators.

measurement

A named list mapping the factors to their indicators. The two factors of a pair need the same number of indicators, in matching order.

pairs

A list of character vectors of length two, each naming an X and a Y factor of measurement. With several pairs, all factors are estimated in one model with free covariances. The default pairs the two factors of a two-factor measurement.

free_intercepts

Names of indicators whose intercept is not shared within its pair. Naming either member frees the pair. When given, a "partial" level is fitted between "metric" and "scalar". At least one matched pair of each X/Y factor pair must keep its shared intercept.

blocks

Named list of Mplus input blocks, as in create_rsa_mplus_model(). The defaults are ESTIMATOR = MLR; and OUTPUT: STDYX;.

usevariables

Columns of data to export. Defaults to the indicators in measurement.

modelout

Path of an Mplus .inp file that names the set. Each level is written next to it with its name appended, for example inv_metric.inp for modelout = "inv.inp", and all levels read the data file inv.dat. On a case-sensitive file system the file name must be lower case (see write_rsa_mplus_model()).

overwrite

If TRUE, replace existing input and data files.

run

If TRUE (the default), run the models. If FALSE, only write the input and data files.

Mplus_command

Optional path or command used to invoke Mplus.

quiet

If TRUE, suppress status messages from MplusAutomation.

Value

An object of class rsa_mplus_invariance, a list with

  • models: the named list of workflows, one per level.

  • comparison: a data frame with one row per level: level, k, chisq, df, scaling, CFI, RMSEA, SRMR, the level it is tested against, delta_CFI, and the scaled difference test (diff_chisq, diff_df, diff_p). It is NULL when run = FALSE.

  • files: the input paths, named by level, and the shared data path.

Details

The levels are:

  • "configural": the same factor structure, all loadings and intercepts free (marker loadings fixed at 1, factor means at 0).

  • "metric": matched indicators share their loading.

  • "partial": metric, and matched indicators share their intercept except those in free_intercepts. The Y factor mean is freed.

  • "scalar": metric, and all matched indicators share their intercept.

comparison tests each level against a less restricted one with the Satorra-Bentler scaled chi-square difference: metric against configural, and partial and scalar each against metric. delta_CFI is the change in CFI relative to the same model.

See also

create_rsa_mplus_model()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
invariance <- fit_rsa_mplus_invariance(
  data = dat,
  measurement = list(
    X = c("x1", "x2", "x3"),
    Y = c("y1", "y2", "y3")
  ),
  free_intercepts = "x2",
  modelout = "invariance/inv.inp"
)
invariance$comparison
} # }
